# jBC Programmers Reference Guide

> An unofficial reference for jBC, the Basic-like programming language of the
> jBASE multi-value database, used in Temenos TAFC and TAFJ and in T24. It
> covers syntax, compilation, environment variables, data files, system
> variables and every function and statement, with notes on where TAFJ behaves
> differently from TAFC.

Every chapter below is a Markdown file. The whole guide in one file is at
{{base}}llms-full.txt ({{size}}). This is not a Temenos document.
